whatsNew.en-US:
A refreshed design makes prompts easier to browse, search, save, and customize.

Use Apple Intelligence to run prompts, ask follow-up questions, translate, and get suggestions for template values and prompt details.

Search in natural language, create images with Image Playground, share cards, and access prompts through Spotlight, Siri, Shortcuts, and Control Center.

AI features vary by device, iOS version, language, and region.
whatsNew.zh-Hans:
焕新的界面，让浏览、搜索、收藏和自定义提示词更加轻松。

使用 Apple 智能运行提示词、继续追问、翻译提示词，并获取模板变量和提示词详情的建议。

用自然语言搜索，通过图乐园生成图像，分享卡片，还可通过聚焦、Siri、快捷指令和控制中心访问提示词。

AI 功能的可用性因设备、iOS 版本、语言和地区而异。
